status: frozen before the development comparison; not promotion criteria
treatment: same frozen product binary, shadow control versus evidence exposure
rationale: A 10 percentage-point gain means one additional evidence-grounded success per ten attempted tasks and is the minimum agent-facing improvement considered worth claiming.
A 0.5 repair-turn gain means one fewer recovery turn for every two tasks; failures remain charged the full registered turn budget.
The target alternative is larger than each positive primary margin; it is not an estimate of the effect.
Ordinary-workflow cases are an explicit guard against degrading common factual recall. Their task-success margin allows at most one additional failure per ten cases.
Resource ceilings and the joint power method must be set after the pilot using observed family-cluster variance, before any confirmatory outcomes are opened.
